boundary: Every image receives an autonomous workflow output: AUTONOMOUS_NONREFERABLE, AUTONOMOUS_REFERABLE, or AUTONOMOUS_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_REACQUIRE. This is not every-image binary diagnosis.
dataset_scope: DDR public subset held-out test, common set n=1435 with 946 referable and 489 nonreferable images.
score_preprocessing: rank-normalize each candidate score within split before weighted mixture for accepted random-mixture modes
selection_protocol: Thresholds selected on validation under zero false-negative clearance and specificity constraints; held-out test read once for reported metrics.

rejected_models.standalone_public_classifiers: Did not improve the baseline as direct replacement policies.
rejected_models.learned_augmented_fusion: Rejected because learned fusion introduced false-negative clearances on held-out test despite higher nominal coverage.
